description: Session-start detection of Korean documents, plus write-time gates on the artifacts these skills produce. Detection is silent where no marker matches. The Korean audit (the glossary word check and the sentence-rule pack) runs on each written file in projects that have a project glossary (.claude/GLOSSARY.md or GLOSSARY.md); the SVG lint runs on the files themselves and is turned off per project in .claude/simplecore.json.
